Yes, that response feels right. When I tried to save plain text that isn't really a web address, nothing got added — the collection stayed empty — and the address box flagged it so I know to fix what I typed. That's what I'd want: it shouldn't clutter my bookmarks with something that doesn't actually point to a page, and it should tell me why rather than silently doing nothing.

That handles the bad-input case well.
